fields.description: Issue features editorials and commentary on a sensational police investigation in Miami, including discussion of alleged jail torture and indictments involving the police department and criticism of city commissioners. Coverage includes debate over municipal spending and whether Miami should employ a local municipal band versus an outside band, along with political campaign news and advertisements for local and state offices ahead of the June 1928 Democratic primary. Additional local items address public health concerns (mattress sterilization), tourism and preparations for visiting Shriners, city infrastructure and beautification (parks, bridges, sidewalks), entertainment listings, sports/fight promotion, legal notices, and extensive commercial advertising.
